design_system.theme: Premium playful alphabet workbench: dark ink background with warm paper panels, colorful letter tiles with hard offset shadows, angular slanted section joins, serif display type against a sans body, strong contrast, restrained motion (single staggered tile entrance and subtle hover lifts, both disabled under prefers-reduced-motion). Deliberately avoids generic template card grids in favor of editorial split columns, numbered step rails, vertical flow badges, and staggered tile trays.

palette.text: #f2e7cf on ink / #261d10 on paper; dim variants #c9b894 / #5c4c32
palette.accent: #f0a13a amber (accent-ink #b06f12 on paper); tile colors coral #e8604c, amber #f0a13a, teal #2f9c8c, violet #8b63c9, leaf #7ba23f, blue #4a80b4

design_system.font_strategy: System-only stacks, zero downloaded fonts: display Iowan Old Style/Palatino/Georgia serif for headlines, tiles and numerals; ui-sans-serif system stack for body; ui-monospace stack for eyebrows, table headers, codes and badges.
responsive_rules: Base (<=479px, covers 375): single column, hero stacks text over tray, CTAs full-width, nav wraps, tables scroll inside .table-scroll, flow badges stay vertical, lanes drop the arrow
48rem and up (covers 768): hero 7fr/5fr text-tray grid, editorial .split 5fr/7fr with sticky intro column, even steps indented by 3rem, guide lanes go two-up, footer three columns
90rem and up (covers 1440): content capped at 70rem max-width with wider gutters; no full-bleed stretch
All widths: overflow-x clip on html/body, verified no horizontal overflow at 375, 768, 1440 on all six routes
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables scroll-behavior smoothness, all animations and transitions; no-preference gate enables tile entrance and hover lifts only
Keyboard: visible :focus-visible 3px amber outline on all interactive elements; skip link becomes visible on first Tab

hero.headline: Collect every letter. A to Z.
hero.subheadline: Collect The Alphabet is a Roblox collector by Cosmic Collection where you open letter packs, mount letters on your board, and earn Money every second — all the way from A through Z. This wiki walks you from your first pack to a full alphabet.

secondary_cta.label: Official game on Roblox
secondary_cta.note: Clearly labeled secondary external link; opens in a new tab. The largest, visually dominant CTA is the internal Beginner Guide button.

sections: Quick start — four numbered steps from first pack to first Money collection, linking to /beginner-guide
Core gameplay loop — Buy/Place/Open/Earn flow with letter-tile strip, linking to /gameplay-loop
Progression route — Word of the Day wall teaser and nine-symbol row, linking to /progression-guide
All guides — numbered link lanes to /beginner-guide, /gameplay-loop, /progression-guide, /common-mistakes, /faq

page_map.purpose: Home: hero with largest CTA 'Start the Beginner Guide' -> /beginner-guide, quick start, core loop preview, progression teaser, guide lanes, labeled secondary official Roblox link
Quick start / first session walkthrough: buy first pack, place on plot pads, wait for READY, carry letters to DROP OFF LETTERS, collect Money, handle duplicates
Core gameplay loop: six-station main loop, duplicates-to-Diamonds sell loop, Word of the Day side loop, Symbol Pack late-game loop
Progression route: Money vs Diamond roles, four upgrade fields (Money Multiplier, Pack Rarity, Pack Time, Pack Amount), nine-symbol collection, daily rewards, group reward, offline hatching
Common errors with fixes: keep-or-sell traps around Word of the Day, variable sell values, empty pack slots, missed E interactions, frozen popups, code casing, empty Sell panel

FAQ & codes: redemption steps (Settings > Codes > Enter Code > Submit), date-checked code 100KMEMBERS, game passes listed at check time, currencies, group reward, update cadence, official-game link section

components: Header (sticky, brand mark tile, wrapping nav with aria-current)
Footer (site links, labeled official-game external link, unofficial-fan disclaimer)
LetterTile (pure CSS letter/symbol tile, role=img with aria-label)
Slant (inline SVG angular section join, aria-hidden)
Steps (numbered step rail with serif numerals)
Flow (vertical-badge process list for the core loop)
Lane (angular internal-link rows with index and arrow)
TierTable (scroll-contained tables for currencies and upgrades)
Skip link, focus-visible outlines, reduced-motion media queries

assets.type: inline SVG favicon (ink square, coral letter tile with letter A)

assets.note: No raster images, no downloaded fonts, no third-party media anywhere in the site; all visuals are original CSS and inline SVG geometry.
